items.exampleEn: The weather can change dramatically in the mountains.
items.exampleZh: 山上的天氣可能會劇烈變化。

items.exampleEn: She works in a field related to computers.
items.exampleZh: 她從事和電腦相關的工作。

items.exampleEn: There is a subtle difference between the two colors.
items.exampleZh: 這兩種顏色之間有細微的差別。

items.exampleEn: Price is a secondary concern; quality comes first.
items.exampleZh: 價格是次要考量；品質才是第一。

items.exampleEn: He made a genuine effort to be on time.
The complexity of the tax system confuses many people.
items.exampleZh: 稅務制度的複雜性讓很多人困惑。

items.exampleEn: Lava is fluid when it is very hot.
items.exampleZh: 熔岩在非常高溫時是流動的。

items.exampleEn: The cat was almost invisible in the dark.
items.exampleZh: 那隻貓在黑暗中幾乎看不見。

items.sentenceEn: The second problem is closely related to the first one.
items.sentenceZh: 第二個問題和第一個問題密切相關。

items.audioEn: Our sales have dropped dramatically since the new store opened nearby.
items.audioZh: 自從附近開了新店，我們的銷售量就大幅下滑。
items.questionZh: 附近開了新店之後，發生了什麼事？

items.sentenceEn: Her smile showed genuine joy when she saw the gift.
items.sentenceZh: 她看到禮物時的笑容流露出真正的喜悅。

items.sentenceEn: The schedule is still fluid, so please check it again tomorrow.
items.sentenceZh: 時程還沒確定，所以請明天再確認一次。

items.stemEn: The change was so ____ that few people noticed it.
items.stemZh: 這個改變很細微，所以很少人注意到。

items.stemEn: Air is ____, but we can feel it when the wind blows.
items.stemZh: 空氣是看不見的，但風吹的時候我們能感覺到它。

items.passageEn: Last weekend, I watched a magic show with my nephew. Admittedly, I did not expect much at first. The magician made coins appear and disappear, and his hand movements were so fluid that the tricks looked real. At one point, a coin seemed to become completely invisible. Afterwards, I read that most tricks depend on subtle movements and secondary actions that pull the audience's attention away. The complexity of the tricks surprised me. The magician's joy on stage was genuine, and the show changed dramatically when he invited my nephew to help. Now my nephew wants a job related to magic!
items.passageZh: 上週末，我和姪子去看了一場魔術表演。不可否認，我一開始並沒抱什麼期待。魔術師讓硬幣出現又消失，他的手部動作非常流暢，讓戲法看起來像真的一樣。有一刻，一枚硬幣好像完全消失不見了。後來我讀到，大部分的戲法靠的是細微的動作，以及把觀眾注意力引開的次要動作。這些戲法的複雜程度讓我很驚訝。魔術師在台上的快樂是真誠的，而當他邀請我姪子上台幫忙時，整場表演起了很大的變化。現在我姪子想從事和魔術有關的工作！

questions.questionZh: 作者後來讀到，大部分的戲法靠什麼？
options: 特殊的機器和事先藏好的硬幣
細微的動作和引開注意力的動作
昂貴的道具和舞台上的燈光與音樂

questions.questionZh: 作者的姪子現在想做什麼？
options: 從事和魔術有關的工作

items.promptZh: 由於這個專案的複雜性，我們需要更多時間。
referenceEn: Because of the complexity of this project, we need more time.
We need more time because of the project's complexity.
rubricZh: complexity 是名詞，常用 the complexity of…（例如 the complexity of this project）
「由於」可寫 because of…、due to… 等

items.promptZh: 專家確認這幅畫是真跡。
referenceEn: The expert confirmed that the painting is genuine.
Experts have confirmed that this painting is genuine.
rubricZh: genuine 表示「真的、非偽造的」（例如 is genuine、was genuine 等）
「確認」可寫，例如 confirmed、said、proved 等；時態可用過去式或現在完成式
